chaos_knight_fundamental_forging.name: Fundamental Forging
chaos_knight_fundamental_forging.description: Chaos Knight's Neutral Items get an additional random enchantment.
chaos_knight_fundamental_forging.note0: The random enchantment can be any available enchantment in that tier except for enchantments with negative effects, including enchantments that are normally not available for Strength heroes.
chaos_knight_fundamental_forging.note1: The random enchantment cannot be the same as the chosen enchantment.

chaos_knight_chaos_bolt.name: Chaos Bolt
chaos_knight_chaos_bolt.description: Throws a mysterious bolt of energy at the target unit. It stuns for a random duration and deals random damage.
chaos_knight_chaos_bolt.shard_description: Causes Chaos Bolt to create a Phantasm illusion to attack the target. This illusion deals %illusion_damage_reduction_pct%%% less damage.
chaos_knight_chaos_bolt.lore: Even the Chaos Knight cannot predict the behavior of this mass of unholy energy.
chaos_knight_chaos_bolt.note0: Stun duration and damage are inversely proportional.
chaos_knight_chaos_bolt.note1: Nearby illusions mimic the throw animation.

chaos_knight_reality_rift.name: Reality Rift
chaos_knight_reality_rift.description: Teleports Chaos Knight, any illusions he has, and the target unit to a point along the line between him and the target. The enemy unit has their armor reduced for %duration%s.
chaos_knight_reality_rift.shard_description: Allows Reality Rift to be cast on any enemy hero that is within 1200 range of you or one of your illusions. Gathers all of your illusions and your hero and teleports them to the target enemy.
chaos_knight_reality_rift.facet_chaos_knight_irrationality: Reality Rift has equal chances of applying Break, Disarm, or Silence for %additional_debuff_duration_percent%%% of the base debuff duration in addition to its normal effects.
chaos_knight_reality_rift.lore: Armageddon moves between worlds, delivering its rider to the target wherever they may be.
chaos_knight_reality_rift.note0: The hero and the target face each other, after which the caster and their illusions immediately attack the target.

chaos_knight_chaos_strike.name: Chaos Strike
chaos_knight_chaos_strike.description: Chaos Knight and his illusions' attacks have a chance to deal a critical strike of varying strength with bonus lifesteal. Lifesteal from creeps is reduced.
chaos_knight_chaos_strike.lore: The unstoppable power of the rider crushes even the thickest armor of those who dare oppose him.

chaos_knight_phantasm.name: Phantasm
chaos_knight_phantasm.description: Summons several phantasmal copies of the Chaos Knight from alternate dimensions. The phantasms are illusions that deal %outgoing_damage_tooltip%%% damage, but take %incoming_damage_tooltip%%% damage.\nDISPEL TYPE: Basic Dispel
chaos_knight_phantasm.scepter_description:
Gains a passive component. When an illusion of Chaos Knight is created, there is a %bonus_illusion_chance%%% chance to create an additional illusion under Chaos Knight's control.

When Phantasm is activated, also creates an illusion of allied heroes globally.
chaos_knight_phantasm.lore: The harbinger of chaos has fought in many worlds and eras. Phantoms of those battles join the hero to crush his enemies.
chaos_knight_phantasm.note0: Removes most negative effects from the hero.
chaos_knight_phantasm.note1: For the first %invuln_duration% sec. of this ability, the hero is invulnerable, avoiding stuns and damage.
chaos_knight_phantasm.agoria_description: All Chaos Knight Illusions are Strong Illusions and take less damage when near him.
chaos_knight_phantasm.agoria_note0: All illusions created by Chaos Knight or of Chaos Knight are Strong Illusions. Chaos Knight's Illusions within %aura_radius% radius have %damage_reduction_pct%%% damage reduction.
chaos_knight_phantasm.agoria_note1: Also applies to Aghanim's Scepter Phantasm Illusions.
chaos_knight_phantasm.agoria_note2: Strong Illusions are not instantly killed by spells.
chaos_knight_phantasm.agoria_note3: Break disables the passive Damage Reduction aura.
